## Univariable Analysis

```{r}
make_prop_table <- function(data, variable) {
  tab <- table(data[[variable]], useNA = "ifany")
  data.frame(
    Variable = variable,
    Category = names(tab),
    Count = as.integer(tab),
    Proportion = round(as.integer(tab) / sum(tab), 4),
    Percent = round(100 * as.integer(tab) / sum(tab), 2),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

make_numeric_summary <- function(data, variable) {
  x <- data[[variable]]
  data.frame(
    Variable = variable,
    Count = sum(!is.na(x)),
    Missing = sum(is.na(x)),
    Mean = round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD = round(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min = round(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Q1 = round(quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Q3 = round(quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max = round(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

make_continuous_prop_table <- function(data, variable) {
  x <- data[[variable]]
  breaks <- unique(quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE))
  groups <- cut(x, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  tab <- table(groups, useNA = "ifany")
  data.frame(
    Variable = variable,
    Category = names(tab),
    Count = as.integer(tab),
    Proportion = round(as.integer(tab) / sum(tab), 4),
    Percent = round(100 * as.integer(tab) / sum(tab), 2),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

unique_counts <- sapply(dropout, function(x) length(unique(x)))
proportion_variables <- names(dropout)[
  sapply(dropout, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) |
    (sapply(dropout, is.numeric) & unique_counts <= 60)
]
continuous_variables <- setdiff(names(dropout), proportion_variables)

proportion_tables <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(proportion_variables, function(variable) {
    make_prop_table(dropout, variable)
  })
)

continuous_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(continuous_variables, function(variable) {
    make_numeric_summary(dropout, variable)
  })
)

continuous_proportion_tables <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(continuous_variables, function(variable) {
    make_continuous_prop_table(dropout, variable)
  })
)
```

## Supervised Machine Learning Models

```{r}
library(nnet)
library(tree)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)

set.seed(0)
n_all <- nrow(dropout)
train_indices <- sample(seq_len(n_all), size = round(0.80 * n_all))

dropout_tr <- dropout[train_indices, ]
dropout_te <- dropout[-train_indices, ]

dropout_tree_data <- dropout
high_level_variables <- names(dropout_tree_data)[
  sapply(dropout_tree_data, function(x) is.factor(x) && length(levels(x)) > 32)
]
high_level_variables <- setdiff(high_level_variables, "Target")

for (variable in high_level_variables) {
  dropout_tree_data[[variable]] <- as.numeric(dropout_tree_data[[variable]])
}

dropout_tree_tr <- dropout_tree_data[train_indices, ]
dropout_tree_te <- dropout_tree_data[-train_indices, ]

model_results <- data.frame(
  Model = character(),
  Train.Error = numeric(),
  Test.Error = numeric(),
  Sensitivity = numeric(),
  Specificity = numeric(),
  AU.ROC = numeric(),
  Prediction.Variance = numeric()
)

make_performance_row <- function(model_name, true_train, pred_train,
                                 true_test, pred_test, test_prob) {
  class_levels <- levels(true_test)
  test_prob <- as.data.frame(test_prob)
  test_prob <- test_prob[, class_levels]

  sensitivity <- specificity <- NULL

  for (class_name in class_levels) {
    FP <- sum(true_test != class_name & pred_test == class_name)
    TP <- sum(true_test == class_name & pred_test == class_name)
    N <- sum(true_test != class_name)
    P <- sum(true_test == class_name)
    FPR <- FP / N
    TPR <- TP / P

    sensitivity[class_name] <- TPR
    specificity[class_name] <- 1 - FPR
  }

  auc_value <- as.numeric(multiclass.roc(true_test, test_prob)$auc)

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Train.Error = mean(pred_train != true_train),
    Test.Error = mean(pred_test != true_test),
    Sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    Specificity = mean(specificity),
    AU.ROC = auc_value,
    Prediction.Variance = mean(apply(test_prob, 2, var))
  )
}
```

### Multivariable Logistic Regression

```{r}
fit_logi <- multinom(Target ~ ., data = dropout_tr, trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 10000)

pred_train_label_logi <- predict(fit_logi, newdata = dropout_tr)
pred_test_label_logi <- predict(fit_logi, newdata = dropout_te)
pred_test_prob_logi <- predict(fit_logi, newdata = dropout_te, type = "probs")

table(true = dropout_tr$Target, predicted = pred_train_label_logi)
table(true = dropout_te$Target, predicted = pred_test_label_logi)

model_results <- rbind(
  model_results,
  make_performance_row(
    model_name = "Multivariable logistic regression",
    true_train = dropout_tr$Target,
    pred_train = pred_train_label_logi,
    true_test = dropout_te$Target,
    pred_test = pred_test_label_logi,
    test_prob = pred_test_prob_logi
  )
)

model_results
```

### Classification Tree With Cost-Complexity Pruning

```{r}
tree_control <- tree.control(
  nobs = nrow(dropout_tree_tr),
  minsize = 5,
  mindev = 0
)

dropout_tree <- tree(
  Target ~ .,
  data = dropout_tree_tr,
  control = tree_control
)

plot(dropout_tree)
text(dropout_tree, pretty = 0)
```

```{r}
set.seed(0)
cv_dropout <- cv.tree(dropout_tree)
cv_dropout_df <- data.frame(
  size = cv_dropout$size,
  deviance = cv_dropout$dev
)

best_size <- cv_dropout$size[which.min(cv_dropout$dev)]
best_size

plot(cv_dropout_df$size, cv_dropout_df$deviance,
     type = "b",
     xlab = "Tree size",
     ylab = "Cross-validation deviance")
abline(v = best_size, col = "red")
```

```{r}
candidate_sizes <- 2:10
tree_size_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(candidate_sizes, function(size) {
    pruned_tree <- prune.tree(dropout_tree, best = size)
    train_pred <- predict(
      pruned_tree,
      newdata = dropout_tree_tr,
      type = "class"
    )
    test_pred <- predict(
      pruned_tree,
      newdata = dropout_tree_te,
      type = "class"
    )
    data.frame(
      Tree.Size = size,
      Train.Error = mean(train_pred != dropout_tr$Target),
      Test.Error = mean(test_pred != dropout_te$Target)
    )
  })
)

knitr::kable(tree_size_results, row.names = FALSE)

diagnostic_tree_size <- 4
diagnostic_tree_size
```

```{r}
dropout_tree_final <- prune.tree(dropout_tree, best = best_size)
dropout_tree_diagnostic <- prune.tree(dropout_tree, best = diagnostic_tree_size)

plot(dropout_tree_final)
text(dropout_tree_final, pretty = 0, cex = 0.6)
```

```{r fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
plot(dropout_tree_diagnostic)
text(dropout_tree_diagnostic, pretty = 0, cex = 0.7)
```

### Bagging

```{r}
set.seed(1)
p <- ncol(dropout_tr) - 1

bag_dropout <- randomForest(
  Target ~ .,
  data = dropout_tree_data,
  subset = train_indices,
  mtry = p,
  importance = TRUE
)

bag_dropout

pred_train_label_bag <- predict(bag_dropout, newdata = dropout_tree_tr)
pred_test_label_bag <- predict(bag_dropout, newdata = dropout_tree_te)
pred_test_prob_bag <- predict(
  bag_dropout,
  newdata = dropout_tree_te,
  type = "prob"
)

table(true = dropout_tr$Target, predicted = pred_train_label_bag)
table(true = dropout_te$Target, predicted = pred_test_label_bag)

model_results <- rbind(
  model_results,
  make_performance_row(
    model_name = "Bagging",
    true_train = dropout_tr$Target,
    pred_train = pred_train_label_bag,
    true_test = dropout_te$Target,
    pred_test = pred_test_label_bag,
    test_prob = pred_test_prob_bag
  )
)

importance(bag_dropout)
varImpPlot(bag_dropout)
```
